title: Card Tips in the Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan Bank Accrued Net
content:
**Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan.** For the bank accrued net of a next-business-day transfer to the worker's bank account, card tips lines count in the part the tips share provides.

Card tips lines count toward the bank accrued net at the tips share: on a tier whose card tips count toward accrual, one half when no card tips sync line carries the pay date of the plan's latest period close line, and three quarters when one to three do; in full on such a tier otherwise, and not at all on a tier whose card tips do not count.

| Tier counts card tips | Card tips sync lines carrying the latest period close's pay date | Tips share |
|---|---|---|
| yes | none | one half |
| yes | 1 to 3 | three quarters |
| yes | 4 or more | in full |
| no | any | not at all |

*Hypothetical:* on a tier that counts card tips, current-period card tips of 64.80 USD count as 32.40 USD when the last closed pay period carried no card tips line, as 48.60 USD when it carried two, and as 64.80 USD when it carried five.
